name: PHP & PostgreSQL Integrated Container
postCreateCommand: sudo service postgresql start && sleep 5 && cd /workspace/php-postgres-app && sudo -u postgres psql -c 'CREATE DATABASE appdb;' || true && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER appuser WITH PASSWORD 'password';" || true && sudo -u postgres psql -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE appdb TO appuser;' || true && export DB_HOST=localhost DB_NAME=appdb DB_USER=appuser DB_PASSWORD=password && php src/init_db.php && php src/run_migration.php
